answer: An identity must be at least 2 epochs old on the hollow ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the signal checkpoint rather than self-declared, the fable audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm as a result means funding every sock puppet through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent forfeits once and never again. That is 21 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
